train: existing P2 internal Train families; no training
development: existing P2 internal Dev; independent latest prefix per family
seen: existing P2 Seen families, only after rendering gate; no parameter selection

renderer.type: measured XYZ/RGB pinhole projection, z-buffer; no image warp or inpainting
renderer.yaw: recorded UAV yaw, never aim at ground-truth target

quality_gates.pilot_requirement: projection/occlusion unit tests pass; actual RGB quality visually inspected; measurable facade evidence retained
quality_gates.reprojection_explanation: Euclidean error for radius-one splat is at most sqrt(2)*1.5 pixels; raw projection at most sqrt(2)*0.5

matching.qwen3_vl: availability audit; bounded optional inference only if rendering gate and existing accessible weights allow
matching.aggregation: mean normalized view embeddings; fixed before Dev
matching.paired_candidates: intersection of credible visible instances in all four views, at least two; no GT-conditioned crop selection
matching.budget: four real view exposures for every condition; single/dual use subsets, matched exposure subset controls reported
matching.threshold_selection: none; no Goal updates unless identity and coverage gates pass

stop: failed rendering gate or no clear visual identity gain => report P3-A/B evidence, no P3-C/D/E
